editorial.blurb: NoodleBird serves vibrant Asian street food in a chill fast-casual setting, where buttery hand pies and hand-rolled noodles sit alongside some of Chicago's best egg tarts.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the XO hand-rolled noodles with shrimp and a house soda (the ginger lemon & turmeric is perfectly tart) to cut through the rich sauce, then finish with an egg tart—the custardy pastry is a consistent standout worth saving room for.
signatureDishes: XO Hand Rolled Noodles with Shrimp
